selfScan.dialogDescription: Print this code and display it at the checkpoint. Athletes scan it with the app; their phone's location confirms they are there.
selfScan.secretWarning: Treat this code as a secret. If a photo of it is shared, rotate it and replace the printed copy.
selfScan.loadFailed: The self-scan code could not be loaded.
selfScan.rotateConfirm: Rotating invalidates every printed copy of this code. Continue?
selfScan.rotated: Code rotated. Replace the printed copy at the checkpoint.
selfScan.rotateFailed: The code could not be rotated.
selfScan.notAvailable: Start and finish times come from official timing, so these checkpoints have no self-scan code.

claims.title: Self-scans awaiting review
claims.description: These scans used a valid checkpoint code, but the athlete's location could not confirm they were there. They do not affect official timing until approved.
claims.loadFailed: Self-scans awaiting review could not be loaded.
claims.superseded: Official timing already exists for this checkpoint, so the self-scan was closed.
claims.decisionFailed: The decision could not be saved.

correction.reasonRequired: Enter a reason of at least 5 characters. Every time correction is recorded with its reason.

passes.expectedHelp: Use more than 1 for loop courses. The last crossing at a finish checkpoint is the finish.
passes.firstPassIsStart: This mat is also the start (the first crossing is the chip start)

recordActions.title: Records — {{name}}
recordActions.bibRequired: Enter the bib number of the athlete this time belongs to.

heading.reassign: Move the time for {{name}} to another athlete

help.void: The time is removed from results but kept with your reason, and it can be restored later.
help.restore: The time counts in results again. Restoring is refused if the athlete already has a time here.
help.reassign: The time is voided for this athlete and recorded for the athlete whose bib you enter.

done.reassign: Time moved to the correct athlete

errors.TIMING_SLOT_OCCUPIED: That athlete already has a time at this checkpoint. Void it first.
errors.REASSIGN_SAME_PARTICIPANT: The time already belongs to this athlete.
errors.PARTICIPANT_NOT_ENTERED: That athlete is not an accepted entrant in this race.
errors.RESULTS_CERTIFIED: Results are certified. Reopen them before changing times.
errors.CORRECTION_REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a reason of at least 5 characters.
